docs.summary: Watches the Assets/ directory for file changes using FileSystemWatcher. Debounces and coalesces events for processing on the main thread.
Creates a FileSystemWatcher on the given directory and begins monitoring for file changes.
Stops monitoring and disposes the underlying FileSystemWatcher.
Called on the main thread each frame. Returns debounced, coalesced events.

params.force: Skip the debounce wait and return whatever is queued right now. For callers that must not run against stale state (starting a build, regaining focus) and would otherwise race the debounce window.

docs.summary: Stops the watcher and releases all resources.
